subject: Request: greenlight for backfill + proposed interview cadence
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: greenlight for backfill + proposed interview cadence

Team —

We need approval to open a backfill req for the Senior Inference Engineer on my team (replacement for Alex M., who is moving to Infra). This is a high-priority hiring lane: two active customer migrations depend on reducing MTTR in the inference runtime, and we have a clear skills gap around latency debugging and kernel-level perf.

Attached: the JD (v3) and the headcount request form with proposed level and comp band. High-level ask: authorize opening the req and allow a 4-week fast-track interview cadence (phone screen -> technical take-home -> 1.5h onsite panel). Proposed interview panel: Marcus (tech lead), Markus (principal), Monica (recruiter), and me for final culture/ops fit.

Budget note: I propose using the remaining bucket in Q2 hiring commit (cost center 1042). If we need a formal allocation, Hannah — can you confirm whether we should route this to the hiring committee or if we can proceed under the delegated approval for infra backfills?

Next steps if approved: Monica will engage OnPoint Talent for active sourcing and I will schedule panel slots the week after approval.

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_Senior_Inference_Engineer_JD_v3.pdf (pdf), headcount-request-form-grace-20270525.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: greenlight for backfill + proposed interview cadence

Grace —

Thanks for the clear summary. I reviewed the JD and the headcount form. Good rationale for a fast track. A couple quick asks before I sign off formally:

- Please confirm the exact comp band (expected midpoint) and if you expect relocation or sign-on.
- Can you confirm the org impact if this sits open another 8 weeks (we may need to justify priority to Finance).
- If the candidate grade is above L6, this will need a short note to exec hiring committee (I can escalate once you confirm).

If you can reply with the comp midpoint and the 8-week impact note today, I'll approve under delegated authority and Monica can kick sourcing.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: greenlight for backfill + proposed interview cadence

Grace — quick technical add: please include in the panel brief a short exercise around KV cache and long-context memory management (15–20 min). I'd like to see practical reasoning on cache invalidation and how they'd diagnose a KV cache leak under production load. If we include a short take-home focusing on a perf-profiling scenario, it will accelerate smile/no-smile decisions.

I can host the panel slot on 6/7 and 6/9 afternoons if that helps narrow scheduling.

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: greenlight for backfill + proposed interview cadence

Hannah —

Comp midpoint: $230k (target band L6). No relocation budget for this req; we will consider sign-on in exceptional cases only.

Impact if open 8 weeks: delayed load-time regression fixes on two customer migrations (estimated 6–8% higher token cost for affected pipelines) and longer on-call rotations for the current team (adds ~8 hours/week across two engineers). I will add a short note in the headcount form.

Marcus — noted on the KV cache exercise. Monica, can you prepare a 1-hr panel brief (15 min candidate exercise + 45 min Q&A) and a short one-page take-home scenario? If we get approval today, I ask we aim for a candidate slate the week of 6/7.

Thanks —
Grace

[Quoted message included below]

Grace/Hannah —

Thanks — marking this as priority. I'll:
- Open req in Greenhouse and tag for fast-track (REQ-1154).
- Share a one-page panel brief and the KV cache take-home draft by EOD tomorrow.
- Loop OnPoint (Sarah) for sourcing and set expectations on the L6 band.

Scheduling note: I'm holding tentative 6/7 and 6/9 1–4pm windows for the panel. Once you confirm approval, I'll book candidate slots and send calendar invites with prep materials and the exercise.

Monica
Talent Partner — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced (to be uploaded to Greenhouse): panel-brief-0615.pdf (draft), kv-cache-takehome-v1.md (md)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Grace — approved under delegated authority. Monica: proceed with creating the req and sourcing. Please mark as "fast-track" and notify Finance of the comp midpoint $230k under cost center 1042. No relocation; sign-on optional (manager approval).

Hannah
VP, People Operations
